Unexpected Delight - Off the main tourist path - Excellent food and service
Apr 2016 • Solo
I had only been in Hanoi for about one week and was surprised I hadn't found more seafood restaurants. Many of the Bia Hoi locations have some seafood selections, but they all seem to have the same types of menus - Lau (hot pots) with fish or prawns, some sauteed clams, jellyfish salad, sauteed or fried fish, etc. Nothing raw or fresh. Again, I'd only been in Hanoi for one week so I hadn't found all the local spots yet. I was walking around Truc Bach lake and found this place walking to the bus stop. What a nice surprise!

The place is very clean and the staff are very nice and helpful. They brought me a cold tea as I looked over the menu and although my Vietnamese is limited and their English was limited, we worked through the menu. There was some misunderstanding and I didn't know the plates were so large, but that was totally my fault and the food was so good I didn't mind. 

It's a family style restaurant. So the portions are not individual size. I ordered the jellyfish salad and green salad and corn salad. I thought they were going to be tiny, tapas size, because it was so cheap. But they were on larger plates, probably for 2-3 people. The man cancelled my stir fried noodles (my xao) with seafood and vegetables order, once he realized I was eating alone. I would have taken it home, since it was my fault, but they were very kind. I kept my other orders of oysters and scallops. They sell them per piece and serve them in different ways - with bacon, baked with cheese, sauteed with shallots and garlic, etc. They were all tasty. I ate enough for 2 people, and had a beer, and the total bill was only 180,000 dong - around $8.

If you're in the Truc Bach area, walk away from the overpriced, subpar expat cafes and walk towards the main road north of the lake. There is a row of restaurants along that street. I plan on going back to check them all out. This one was great, and I will be going back to finish trying the other items on their menu!
